# Skillmark

> Skillmark makes Hermes install a community skill only if an ID-verified human signed it, pays the author on delivery, and pulls it from every agent on the next audit after that author's key is revoked. Testnet only. Verification limits damage; it does not prove the skill is safe, and the Hermes scanner still decides “dangerous”.

- [Set up in Hermes](https://skillmark-index.onrender.com/docs/hermes.md): install `skillmark@0.3.1` from npm, add the MCP server, and verify a skill. Written for an agent to execute.
- [Publish a skill](https://skillmark-index.onrender.com/docs/authors.md): keygen, register the key on Concordium CIS-8, sign, publish free or paid.
- [Verify a skill](https://skillmark-index.onrender.com/docs/verify.md): check a signature, key owner and key status from the CLI or the registry MCP.
- [Live catalogue](https://skillmark-index.onrender.com): signed free and paid listings, plus labelled trust-test demos.
- [Publisher record](https://skillmark-index.onrender.com/p/45jkbocxBigmrb4m1UGbv3JabCsaFRyDRfRRRLC5wLwyuiUa5q): observed signing keys, release history and paid installs; not a reputation score.
- [Limits](https://skillmark-index.onrender.com/docs/hermes.md#limits): what “verified” does and does not mean.

Index: https://skillmark-index.onrender.com — Repository: https://github.com/PhiBao/skillmark
